description: This file defines a custom ListView class (TaskListView) and an adapter (TaskAdapter) for displaying tasks with accessibility enhancements in an Android application. It handles accessibility event processing and adds accessibility info to list item views.

classes.name: TaskListView
classes.description: A custom ListView that adds extra AccessibilityRecords when its children send accessibility events.

classes.name: TaskAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that provides list item views with accessibility content descriptions, managing task labels and checkboxes.

methods.name: TaskListView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes TaskListView with context and attribute set.

methods.name: onRequestSendAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Overridden method to add custom accessibility records with task priority information.

methods.name: TaskAdapter
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the adapter with context, labels, and checkbox states.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses list item views, setting labels, checkboxes, and content descriptions for accessibility.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the label of the task at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.
